name: skills
one_liner: A free library of example templates showing how to teach an AI assistant to do specific jobs, like formatting documents or reviewing code a certain way.
buyer: A consultancy that builds custom AI-assistant workflows for enterprise clients and wants proven templates instead of starting from a blank page.
business_use_cases: A consultancy uses these as starting templates to quickly build and sell branded, custom skills to enterprise clients.
A trainer runs paid workshops teaching teams to write their own skills, using these as worked examples.
A SaaS packages a curated, maintained set of business-specific skills (invoicing, reporting) as a subscription add-on for teams already using Claude.

money_ideas.idea: Custom skill development for enterprise clients, built from these templates
Managed, maintained skill-pack subscription for a specific industry

steal_this: Pick one narrow business process (e.g. writing real-estate listing descriptions) and ship a polished, sellable skill package this weekend using these as a starting template.
